title: Haryana inspector among 6 cops booked on murder charges in ‘custodial death’ case

ai.summary: Haryana police booked six officers, including an inspector, on murder charges following the custodial death of a 30-year-old man in police custody, with protests by family and villagers demanding justice.

facts.claim: Haryana police booked six officers, including an inspector, on murder charges
facts.quote: A day after a man allegedly died in police custody, the Karnal police booked six of their own personnel, including an inspector-rank in-charge, on murder charges on Sunday.
This follows the death of 30-year-old Jitender Singh from Bijna village under mysterious circumstances while in the custody of CIA-2

facts.claim: The victim's family and villagers protested demanding arrests and an investigation
facts.quote: On Sunday, tension prevailed in Karnal city after the victim’s family, relatives and villagers staged a protest demanding an FIR against the cops.

facts.claim: The police formed an SIT to investigate
facts.quote: The case was registered and Ram Nagar SHO is conducting an investigation. Senior officials will form an SIT soon to probe the matter

ai.background_note: Haryana government has a policy for compensation in cases of unnatural death in police custody due to torture or beating, with 50% of compensation deducted from the erring officer's salary.
